description: Remove something the caller owns on autario: a dataset, all rows of a dataset, an app, or an accepted data edit. Cannot be undone.

action.description: Which operation to run. dataset = delete your dataset, needs dataset_id; rows = delete every row of your dataset, needs dataset_id; app = delete your app and its data, needs app_id, confirm; overlay = remove one accepted edit, needs dataset_id, id.

app_id.description: Id of an app you own, as returned by apps action "create". An app you do not own answers not found.

confirm.description: Must be true. A call without it deletes nothing.

dataset_id.description: dataset: The UUID of the dataset to permanently delete rows: The UUID of the dataset to clear all rows from overlay: The UUID of the dataset

name: delete
